title: Japan Delights | Group Tour Package
highlights: Discover Japan's rich cultural tapestry, blending ancient traditions with modern innovations in a land of stunning landscapes and vibrant cities.
Explore Meiji Shrine, a serene Shinto sanctuary set within a lush forest in Tokyo with impressive torii gates and wooden architecture.
Admire the beauty of Big Buddha (Daibutsu), a towering 43.8-foot bronze statue standing proudly, known as the symbol of Japan's spiritual heritage.
Marvel at Nikko Toshogu Shrine, an ornate and intricately designed World Heritage site dedicated to Tokugawa Ieyasu, Japan's first shogun.
Wander through Odawara Castle, a historic fortress known for its impressive architecture and scenic hilltop location.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Shinagawa Prince Hotel
3 nights stay in Tokyo with breakfast
1 night stay in Kyoto with breakfast
1 night stay in Nagano with breakfast
Trip to Zenkoji Temple and Monkey Park
1 night stay in Shibukawa with breakfast
Visit to Hokoku-ji and Sugimoto Dera
1 night stay in Odawara with breakfast
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: You should carry your passport and visa at the time of arrival.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage to any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
The hotels are subject to their availability. The travelers will be accommodated at a property of a similar standard if they are unavailable.
Please be aware that the package does not cover the cost of the visa, which must be obtained separately.
Any activities or transfers not specified in the itinerary are not part of the package and require separate arrangements.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Leisure Time in Shinjuku District
days.desc: Welcome to Japan! Upon arrival at Narita International Airport, get transferred to the hotel. Check in and board the metro train (tickets included) to Shinjuku District. Here, you can experience the buzzing streets of Shinjuku District and explore the streets filled with tiny restaurants and bars. Later, you can visit Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden and other attractions. Then, board the metro train back to Tokyo. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, embark on a journey to explore Tokyo. Start with a visit to Zojoji Temple, which offers scenic views of Tokyo Tower. Then, experience the bustling Shibuya Crossing, the world's busiest intersection, and visit the Meiji Shrine. Then, travel along Omotesando Street, where you can admire the view of the Imperial Palace. After that, explore Nijubashi Bridge, the Sensoji Temple, and other attractions. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Kyoto Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After checking out, board the Bullet Train (tickets included) from Tokyo to Kyoto. Upon arrival, check in and get ready to explore the city. Enjoy the scenic views of the Shinto Shrine of Fushimi Inari, the Imperial Palace, and Kinkakuji Temple, known as the "Golden Pavilion" with its beautiful gardens.  Then, get transferred to Gion, renowned for geisha performers, where you can visit Yosaka Shrine and Kenninji Temple. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Nagano | En route visit Tsumago and Matsumoto
days.desc: Post check out, get ready to embark on a scenic getaway to the countryside. On the way, make a stop at Tsumago, where you can explore the Tsumago Castle and stroll along the scenic Nakasendo Trail, famous for its breathtaking views. Then, experience the beauty of Matsumoto, where we will visit the impressive 16th-century “Crow Castle.” Afterward, you can explore Matsumoto Castle, the Matsumoto City Museum of Art, and other attractions. Afterward, continue to Nagano and check in upon arrival.

days.title: Transfer to Ikaho | Trip to Zenkoji Temple | Visit to Monkey Park | Leisure Time in Kusatsu
days.desc: In the morning, check out and transfer to Ikaho. Along the way, stop at Zenkoji Temple in Nagano, home to Japan’s first Buddhist image. Then, explore the scenic Japanese Alps and visit Monkey Park, where you can see Japanese macaques in their natural habitat. Continue to Kusatsu, a lively spa town with open-air onsens. Finally, head to Ikaho, famous for its historic staircase streets. Later, get transferred to Ryokan, where you can relax in the hot spring baths and rest overnight.

items.title: Trip to Zenkoji Temple and Monkey Park

days.title: Transfer to Tokyo | En Route Nikko Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After checking out, get transferred to Tokyo. En route, visit Nikko, and explore the impressive Nikko-Toshogu Temple and Hall of the Crying Dragon. Then, visit the serene Taiyuinbyo mausoleum, designed with a blend of Japanese and Chinese architectural influences. Enjoy a stroll by the river in Kanmangafuchi, where you will witness hundreds of Jizo statues. After that, you can enjoy some leisure time. Later, get transferred to Tokyo. Check into your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Hotel Metropolitan Sendai East

days.title: Transfer to Odawara | En-route Visit Kamakura and Enoshima
days.desc: After checking out of the hotel, board your transfer to Odawara.  En route, explore Kamakura’s Hokoku Ji Zen Temple and Sugimoto-dera. Then get transferred to Komachi Street, where you can explore the vibrant shopping street. Afterward, visit Kotoku-In, housing the Big Buddha (Daibutsu). Next stop will be Enoshima, where you can spend your time at leisure. Later, visit Odawara Castle, a medieval fortress offering panoramic views of the city. Finally, get transferred to your hotel and check-in.

items.title: Visit to Hokoku-ji and Sugimoto Dera

days.title: Transfer to Tokyo | Visit Owakudani and Oshino Hakkai | Boat Ride on Kawaguchiko Lake | Ascend to Mount Fuji | Departure Day
days.desc: After checking out, get transferred to Tokyo. Then, head to the Hakone region near Mount Fuji, known for the panoramic beauty of lakes and mountains. Next, explore Owakudani, known for its geothermal activity and black eggs. En route, visit Oshino Hakkai, a village with 8 ponds and natural landscape. Continue to Kawaguchiko for a boat ride on Lake Kawaguchiko and ascend to Mount Fuji’s “fifth station.” Later, get transferred to Tokyo to board your flight back home.
